page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-2 is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 7.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 3.5 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, the instance provides predictable compute performance without the resource sharing typical of burstable tiers. The hardware profile represents an entry-level compute-focused configuration, offering a cost-effective option for workloads that require dedicated processing resources but do not demand large memory capacities or local storage performance.

Due to its 2 vCPUs and 7.0 GB memory capacity, this instance is suited for lightweight compute tasks, small-scale web serving, microservices, and basic utility workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of larger instance sizes.
